reviewer: ChatGPT GPT-6 (bounded same-session AI source review; not independent human QA)

reviewScope.summary: Scoped educational, technical, security and integration review of the M06 candidate against the merged M05 baseline.
evidence: M06 adds 7 lessons and 16 exercises, reaching 39 lessons and 90 exercises across M01-M06.
All 74 previous exercise IDs and content hashes remain unchanged against the M05 index.
Generated Git asset SHA256, byte lengths, source hash and offline references were inspected and consistent.
Owner-provided local output: 20/20 targeted Vitest, 6/6 existing budget tests and 2/2 managed Playwright passed.
Owner-provided production build and budget results: curriculum 212628/218000 B, largest JavaScript raw 494764/500000 B.
No new permanent tests, database migration, XP rules, runtime dependency or GitHub account requirement.
This review is bounded source assessment, not native Windows learner-command validation, independent human QA or hosted release certification.

adversarialFindings.description: Learner PowerShell 5.1 Git exercise sequence has not been independently executed on native Windows.
adversarialFindings.resolution: Commands use an isolated synthetic repository and guarded operations. No native Windows execution success is claimed.

adversarialFindings.description: M06 does not include a dedicated aborted-merge, rebase or cherry-pick practical exercise.
adversarialFindings.resolution: M03 introduces merge --abort; M06 provides bounded practice in restore, reset, stash, reflog and revert. Further interrupted-operation practice remains a pedagogical improvement, not claimed coverage.

adversarialFindings.description: Selected browser scenarios exercise shared Pathways and offline flows rather than an independently completed M06 journey.
adversarialFindings.resolution: Existing provider and lesson-contract tests load and validate all 39 lessons. Hosted CI remains separate and no M06 learner-acceptance claim is made.

adversarialFindings.description: Curriculum and raw JavaScript build margins are approximately 5.3 kB each.
adversarialFindings.resolution: Curriculum ceiling raised only after actual measurement. All other release ceilings remain unchanged; future expansions require separate measurement.

retrospective.summary: Scoped same-session AI source review PASS on the inspected M06 candidate. No confirmed P0/P1 finding remains in this scope. Hosted Final candidate, merge, master certification and production alias are not claimed.
